verdict.line: You lose short trades and all-ins before level 6 while Jax has Q (Leap Strike) and W (Empower) online every 5-7 seconds, but you win the poke war after that as your Q (Snip Snip!) cooldown shrinks and your passive eats his stacked health.

brief.thesis: Jax's kit is built around forcing a short, decisive exchange: Q (Leap Strike) closes the gap, W (Empower) adds burst to the next hit, and E (Counter Strike) dodges your autos before stunning you if you stand and fight. Gwen has no dash-interrupt or hard CC to stop that sequence, so the lane is decided by whether you fight on his terms or force a longer poke exchange where your Q's true-damage center snip and A Thousand Cuts passive punish the bonus health his Equipment Mastery gives him. Because his R (Relentless Assault) has no cooldown and simply rewards consecutive autos, every extended melee trade scales in his favor, not yours.

theirWindow.what: Once he has W (Empower) and E (Counter Strike) online he can leap, empower an auto, and stun you if you swing back. Do not auto-attack into him here — poke with Q's outer snips and back off before he closes the last 400 range.

yourWindow.when: His E (Counter Strike) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With Counter Strike down (18/16/14/12/10s) he has no answer to sustained pressure. Walk up, land 2-3 Q snips for the true-damage center hit and passive proc, then E (Skip 'n Slash) away before his Q (Leap Strike) resets off cooldown.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The extra sustain from two potions matters more here than a Doran's Helm's flat HP, since you're trying to survive Jax's level 1-5 all-in windows without back-and-forth trades (49.7% over 561 games, the standard start).

boots.why: Jax's damage is auto-attack centric — Empower's bonus hit and R (Relentless Assault)'s every-third-attack bonus are both physical — so the flat reduction directly undercuts his stacking pattern (48.6% over 315 games).

core.why: Highest-winrate first item in the strongest recorded path (63.4% over 82 games) and gives the burst your Q poke needs to threaten kills through his bonus health.
Bonus damage to low-health targets synergizes directly with A Thousand Cuts, which already scales off enemy missing/current health.
Completes the highest-winrate path; raw AP scales every Q snip and R needle once the lane is stabilized.

situational.when: he's stacked enough AD/AP that his Empower-augmented all-in threatens to kill you through your passive heal
the game goes long and you need omnivamp to out-sustain his dueling instead of pure burst
you're ahead and want the attack speed to stack more A Thousand Cuts procs during your E (Skip 'n Slash) window

runes.keystoneWhy: Repeated Q (Snip Snip!) snips and E (Skip 'n Slash) on-hit procs stack Conqueror fast in the poke exchanges you're trying to win, and the healing it grants offsets the chip damage from his Empower autos (this page runs 54.1% winrate at 38.9% pick, well ahead of the Inspiration alternative).

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport edges out Flash+Ignite in the measured data (50.6% vs 50%) and fits the matchup's shape — you're not the one threatening early kills, so Teleport lets you reset wave state and use your Q's true-damage clear to punish him for overextending after his all-in windows pass.

playing.title: Never trade into his E cooldown
playing.detail: Counter Strike (18/16/14/12/10s) dodges all incoming basic attacks and stuns you if you auto into it. Track it and only commit autos once it's down.

playing.title: Poke on Empower cooldown, not off it
playing.detail: W (Empower) recharges every 7/6/5/4/3s and telegraphs his next leap or auto as a burst hit. Land your Q snips in the window right after he uses it.

playing.title: Sit at E range, not melee range
playing.detail: Use W (Hallowed Mist) to control when you're targetable and only close distance with E (Skip 'n Slash) when you intend to fight — don't idle in his Q (Leap Strike) range.

playing.title: Cap auto exchanges at two hits
playing.detail: His R (Relentless Assault) has no cooldown and every third consecutive attack deals bonus damage. Extended auto trades scale for him, not you — snip and disengage instead.

playing.title: Center-hit your Q for true damage
playing.detail: Snip Snip!'s center deals true damage and applies your passive, which is the only way to reliably chip through the bonus health his Equipment Mastery passive gives him.

playing.title: Threaten with R from level 6
playing.detail: Needlework's 1200 range lets you poke or finish across the lane without entering his Counter Strike range — use it before committing to an all-in, not just to secure kills.

playing.title: Play for the post-11 spike
playing.detail: Once Q's cooldown drops toward 4.25-3.5s and Shadowflame lands, you out-damage him in prolonged exchanges. Shift from avoidance to forcing fights around then.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the win rates and pick rates are fact. The tactical reasoning — when to poke, when to disengage, and why each item or rune matters against Jax's specific cooldowns — is my own read of the ability interactions.
